Unraid Community Applications from **Theviki20110**.
### feedbard
Polls a list of RSS/Atom feeds, turns each new post into a narrated audio episode — translated into your language, with figures and charts described out loud instead of skipped — and publishes it into an **Audiobookshelf** book library, one folder per article with its own cover art.
Headless: no WebUI. It runs the pipeline on a timer (`CRON_INTERVAL_SECONDS`) and writes to two shares — one for its own state, one for the library your media server reads.
LLM work runs through **Anthropic**, **AWS Bedrock**, or a local **Ollama**; TTS/ASR through an HTTP service, **SageMaker**, or **Amazon Polly**.
Support: open an issue at https://github.com/Theviki20110/feedbard/issues
